description: Lane-choice belief calibration at severe congestion: flat fee versus the canonical D16/K10 mechanism, with each variant's laneLatencyEstimate set to the realized per-lane mean latencies from the uncalibrated 1,000-seed severe-congestion run (flat standard 58.68 slots; canonical standard 58.58, priority 42.74; rounded to whole slots). One calibration round from the uncalibrated equilibrium, not a fixed point.
